name: job_application_pipeline
description: Demo hiring pipeline: validate → auto-screen → parallel assessments → manager review → offer or rejection

inputTemplate.resumeText: 10 years building Python APIs with FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Experience with workflow orchestration and distributed systems.

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var missing = []; if (!$.candidateName) missing.push('candidateName'); if (!$.email) missing.push('email'); if (!$.jobTitle) missing.push('jobTitle'); if (!$.resumeText) missing.push('resumeText'); if (!$.requiredSkills || $.requiredSkills.length === 0) missing.push('requiredSkills'); if (missing.length > 0) { return { valid: false, missingFields: missing }; } return { valid: true, candidateName: $.candidateName, email: $.email, jobTitle: $.jobTitle, skillCount: $.requiredSkills.length }; })()

(function () { var resume = ($.resumeText || '').toLowerCase(); var skills = $.requiredSkills || []; var matched = []; var missed = []; for (var i = 0; i < skills.length; i++) { var skill = String(skills[i]).toLowerCase(); if (resume.indexOf(skill) >= 0) { matched.push(skills[i]); } else { missed.push(skills[i]); } } var score = skills.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((matched.length / skills.length) * 100); var passThreshold = 60; var decision = score >= passThreshold ? 'pass' : 'reject'; return { candidateName: $.candidateName, jobTitle: $.jobTitle, score: score, passThreshold: passThreshold, matchedSkills: matched, missingSkills: missed, decision: decision, summary: $.candidateName + ' scored ' + score + '/100 for ' + $.jobTitle + ' (' + matched.length + '/' + skills.length + ' skills matched)' }; })()

(function () { var s = $.screening; return { status: 'rejected', stage: 'auto_screening', candidateName: s.candidateName, jobTitle: s.jobTitle, score: s.score, reason: 'Below screening threshold of ' + s.passThreshold, missingSkills: s.missingSkills, message: 'Thank you for applying. We are moving forward with other candidates at this time.' }; })()

inputParameters.terminationReason: Candidate did not pass automated resume screening

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var base = $.screeningScore || 0; var variance = Math.floor(Math.random() * 21) - 10; var score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, base + variance)); return { type: 'technical_quiz', score: score, passed: score >= 70, completedAt: new Date().toISOString(), note: 'Simulated coding assessment for ' + $.jobTitle }; })()

(function () { return { type: 'reference_check', status: 'completed', referencesContacted: 2, positiveReferences: 2, flags: [], summary: 'References for ' + $.candidateName + ' (' + $.email + ') responded positively', completedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; })()

(function () { var screeningScore = $.screening.score; var technicalScore = $.technical.score; var referenceBoost = $.references.positiveReferences >= 2 ? 5 : 0; var compositeScore = Math.round((screeningScore * 0.4) + (technicalScore * 0.5) + referenceBoost); var recommendInterview = compositeScore >= 75 && $.technical.passed; return { candidateName: $.candidateName, jobTitle: $.jobTitle, screeningScore: screeningScore, technicalScore: technicalScore, referenceSummary: $.references.summary, compositeScore: compositeScore, recommendInterview: recommendInterview, reviewerBrief: $.candidateName + ' — composite ' + compositeScore + '/100 (screening ' + screeningScore + ', technical ' + technicalScore + '). References: ' + $.references.positiveReferences + '/2 positive.' }; })()

inputParameters.instructions: Review the candidate packet and complete this task with decision: approved or rejected

inputParameters.expression: (function () { return { status: 'offer_extended', candidateName: $.candidateName, email: $.email, jobTitle: $.jobTitle, approvedBy: $.managerReview.approvedBy || 'hiring-manager', comments: $.managerReview.comments || '', compositeScore: $.reviewPacket.compositeScore, offerDetails: { startDate: 'TBD', compensationBand: 'L5 Backend', nextStep: 'Recruiter will send formal offer letter within 2 business days' } }; })()

inputParameters.terminationReason: Hiring manager approved candidate; offer prepared

inputParameters.expression: (function () { return { status: 'rejected', stage: 'hiring_manager_review', candidateName: $.candidateName, jobTitle: $.jobTitle, compositeScore: $.reviewPacket.compositeScore, reviewedBy: $.managerReview.approvedBy || $.managerReview.reviewedBy || 'hiring-manager', comments: $.managerReview.comments || 'Not selected after manager review', message: 'Thank you for your time during our interview process.' }; })()
